explain.en: Browsers Playwright downloaded for automated tests, and the browser profiles AI agents use through it (Playwright MCP, playwright-cli), which can hold their logins to websites. Shown only: to remove the browsers, use Playwright's own uninstall command in Terminal.
explain.zh: Playwright 为自动化测试下载的浏览器，以及 AI 智能体通过它使用的浏览器资料（Playwright MCP、playwright-cli），里面可能有它们登录各网站的记录。这里只显示大小；要删浏览器，请在终端用 Playwright 自带的卸载命令。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: 1.0G (chromium-1208, chromium_headless_shell-1208, firefox-1509, webkit-2248, ffmpeg-1011). macOS 26.6.2.

notes: Protected since 2026-10-10: Playwright MCP keeps persistent browser profiles (with logins) in mcp-<browser>-<hash> inside this folder (createUserDataDir in browserFactory.ts, v1.60.0), and playwright-cli in daemon/. The browser folders themselves (chromium-1208 etc.) change name with every version, so the rule cannot point at just them. PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 keeps browsers inside each project's node_modules; those are not scanned. Playwright's own uninstall command is `npx playwright uninstall --all`; it is not offered as official_cleanup because npx can fetch and run any package.
